title: Police say man whose body lay undiscovered in Sydney bushland for 12 days was killed in suspected hit-and-run
summary_full: Joshua Howard, 31, is believed to have been struck by a car and thrown over the guardrail as he was walking home from a party in Rouse HillGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastThe twin brother of a man whose body lay undiscovered for 12 days after he was killed in a suspected hit and run in Sydney says it has left him feeling like half a person.Joshua Howard was last seen at a bus interchange in Parramatta, in western Sydney, about 10pm on 7 November.
